cutsceneViewBoundsContract.stageCoordinates: actions[].x/y use centered stage units. The canonical 16:9 authoring stage spans X=-8..8 and Y=-4.5..4.5.
cutsceneViewBoundsContract.pathCoordinates: actions[].pathPoints remain normalized viewport coordinates and may extend from -0.25 to 1.25 for offscreen entry/exit.
cutsceneViewBoundsContract.zoom: camera.movement supports zoom, zoom_in, zoom_out, and zoom_in_out. camera.zoomMultiplier below 1 zooms in; above 1 zooms out.
cutsceneViewBoundsContract.zoomInOut: For camera.movement=zoom_in_out, zoomHoldSeconds holds at the peak and zoomReturnMultiplier controls the final framing relative to the authored framing (default 1 = return exactly, without a snap).
cutsceneViewBoundsContract.parallax: camera.parallax is an independent presentation intent and does not change the screen-to-stage coordinate mapping.
